title: 大阪杯の後に・タマモクロスの予告

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creeks runs her race with an air of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Tamamo Cross boastfully informs her that she has identified her weakness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wondering what her weakness could be, she begins to prepare for the spring Tenno Sho.
